abstract: BACKGROUND/PURPOSE: Epithelial tumors of the ovary account for about 15% of pediatric ovarian masses. The authors reviewed a 14-year experience with ovarian masses to understand the spectrum of pathology, presentation, and outcome of children with epithelial lesions. METHODS: All ovarian masses resected or biopsied at the authors' institution from 1988 to the present were reviewed retrospectively. Patient age, presenting symptoms, operative procedures, postoperative treatment, and outcome were obtained from the medical record. RESULTS: A total of 240 cases were identified. A total of 123 (51.2%) were nonneoplastic in nature. Of the 117 neoplastic masses, 79 (67.5%) were germ cell tumors and nineteen (16.2%) were epithelial-derived tumors. Patients with epithelial tumors had a mean age of 13.9 +/- 4 years. Ten patients (52.6%) presented with abdominal pain, and 9 (47.4%) presented with an asymptomatic mass. Eleven underwent oophorectomy, 6 underwent cystectomy, and 2 had biopsy alone. Four patients (21%) had ascites, and 1 (5.3%) had a pleural effusion. The histopathologic diagnoses for the epithelial tumors included 9 serous cystadenomas (47%) and 3 mucinous cystadenomas (16%), 3 mucinous cystadenocarcinomas (16%), and 4 serous tumors of borderline malignancy (21%). Two patients (11%) had bilateral disease. Four patients (21%) underwent a subsequent laparotomy for either staging or recurrence, and 2 patients (11%) required chemotherapy. One patient (5.3%) died of ovarian adenocarcinoma. CONCLUSIONS: Epithelial tumors comprise a small but significant proportion of pediatric ovarian masses. The pediatric surgeon must understand the biologic characteristics, operative management, and follow-up treatment of these tumors, and how these differ from germ cell lesions.

背景/目的：小児卵巣腫瘤の約15%を上皮性腫瘍が占める。著者らは、上皮性病変を有する小児の病理像、臨床像、転帰の全体像を理解するため、14年間の卵巣腫瘤の経験を検討した。
方法：1988年から現在までに当施設で切除または生検された卵巣腫瘤をすべて後方視的に検討した。患者の年齢、初発症状、手術術式、術後治療、転帰は診療録から得た。
結果：計240例が同定された。123例（51.2%）は非腫瘍性であった。腫瘍性の117例のうち、79例（67.5%）が胚細胞腫瘍、19例（16.2%）が上皮由来腫瘍であった。上皮性腫瘍の患者の平均年齢は13.9 ± 4歳であった。10例（52.6%）が腹痛で発症し、9例（47.4%）が無症候性の腫瘤であった。卵巣摘出術11例、嚢腫摘出術6例、生検のみ2例であった。4例（21%）に腹水、1例（5.3%）に胸水が認められた。上皮性腫瘍の組織診断は、漿液性嚢胞腺腫9例（47%）、粘液性嚢胞腺腫3例（16%）、粘液性嚢胞腺癌3例（16%）、境界悪性の漿液性腫瘍4例（21%）であった。両側性病変は2例（11%）であった。4例（21%）は病期分類または再発のため後に開腹術を受け、2例（11%）は化学療法を必要とした。1例（5.3%）は卵巣腺癌で死亡した。
結論：上皮性腫瘍は少ないが無視できない割合で小児卵巣腫瘤を占める。小児外科医は、これらの腫瘍の生物学的特徴、外科的管理、フォローアップ治療、ならびに胚細胞病変との違いを理解しなければならない。
